entities.summary: Mohammad-Javad Ardashir Larijani is an Iranian principlist politician and former diplomat. He was a top adviser to then Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei in foreign affairs and secretary of High Council for Human rights, Judiciary of Islamic Republic of Iran.
